top_choice_rationale: Cărtărescu’s Blinding and Solenoid provide the strongest available evidence of a distinctive and sustained imaginative architecture, in which memory, embodiment and urban space are formally interdependent. Translation from Romanian and incomplete corpus coverage materially qualify this comparative judgment.
recusal_note: No candidate-specific connection is apparent from the supplied profile. It notes institutional committee-colleague relationships with Olsson, Mattson, Swärd and Sem-Sandberg at the Swedish Academy.
